scope.viewerQuestion: 익숙한 장르의 게임을 플레이어가 새로 선택할 이유는 어떻게 만들까?
includedTopics: 서로 받쳐 주는 여러 매력과 고유한 경험

wholeKoEnScriptAndCausalFlow.required: Review every chapter closing/opening as a meaningful pair, then read complete narration without headings; preserve reference order; plan screen/audio handoffs and vary transition forms. Apply thesis-preserving-no-redundant-hedges-v1: preserve the thesis, conclusion, source order and useful depth; omit only redundant hedges, defensive meta-explanations and invented extreme counterclaims that add no essential information. Keep necessary conditions and verify continuity after omissions. Record preserved claims, omitted lines/reasons and retained essential conditions in this plan or the existing review ledger. No claim redesign, word-count deletion quota, extra approval or automatic remake.

allSceneDetailedSubjectsAndMotionPlan.required: Pair each substantive explanation with an appropriate inspected screenshot, illustration or diagram; map claim, source/frame/hash/rights, narration cue, crop, target marks and fixed-caption clearance in each existing scene's visualEvidence. Reveal or change the image with the explanation; verify1080p/mobile and moving transitions. Screenshot slides count as explanation. No decorative filler, reference-lesson assets or additional approval gate.

narrationLevelContinuity.required: Plan consistent speech gain, background-only ducking and speech-safe fades within the existing sample. Review speech-active source PCM, processed narration and final decoded audio with aligned local levels and contextual listening; record unresolved drops, joins and masking in the existing audio report/ledger. Whole-file loudness or ASR alone is insufficient; templates do not implement automatic detection.

brandingMembershipAndThumbnailPlan.required: Keep branding/member identities; plan a viewer-experience/problem/curiosity-first title with 2–3 candidates, truthful script support, exact topic terms and complementary thumbnail. Record the choice in the existing publishing plan, not a separate approval gate. See docs/YOUTUBE_PUBLISHING.md.

referenceStructureAndDetailedPptInsertio.required: Selected article full learning logic/order with paragraph→script→screen mapping, useful examples/reasons/recap, supported corrections and justified noninstructional omissions. See articleFaithfulTeaching.

independentGameplaySourceSeparation.required: All production cuts must refer to independently sourced actual gameplay; research-reference-only media excluded.

rendererChoiceAndActualImplementation.required: Select tool per explanation; verify spatial depth and before/action/result; distinguish actual outputs from illustrative overlays within the existing sample/scene design gate.

brandedUiAndMobileReadability.required: Apply shared tokens/components and restrained brand identity; inspect current full-size/mobile output, actual captions, contrast and moving states in existing QA.

actualFootageFocusAnnotations.required: View actual footage, tie thick hollow shapes/lines and short semantic labels to speech and visible evidence; plan tracked keyframes/occlusion/cuts, reserve fixed captions and UI, verify motion at1080p and375px. Do not fabricate computer-vision results.

nextAction: Complete the selected video through internal QA and four outputs; deliver local output-folder and complete captioned-master links, then wait for review of that exact version before YouTube.

toolRoles.Unity: primary for self-authored game demonstrations and most 3D explanations; also available for 2D explanations when pixel-art/sprite animation, game-state behavior or scene reuse improves understanding; select per scene
toolRoles.MotionCanvas: 2D diagrams, progressive arrows/paths, state labels, captions and compositing
toolRoles.ThreeJS: optional for browser-interactive 3D explanations, beneficial reuse of existing Three.js scenes or another documented scene-specific advantage; not mandatory for rendering-principle explanations
toolRoles.Manim: equation derivations, vectors, matrices, graphs and mathematical transformations

explanationRendering.unityAssetPreference: find and reuse suitable rights-confirmed free pixel-art/sprite assets, models, rigs and animations; record source URL, creator, revision/version, license, attribution, source hash and source-redistribution rights; reuse suitable existing assets without mandatory downloads

animatedRelationships.useWhen: order, dependency, choice, feedback, merging, or tracked spatial relations improve understanding
